description:
Create a flowing PDF document with automatic pagination.

Best for: Reports, articles, letters, contracts, and documents with sequential content.

Content flows naturally from top to bottom. Pages break automatically when content exceeds page height. Use "pageBreak" to force page breaks, "divider" for horizontal rules, and "spacer" for vertical spacing.

Supported content types:
- text: Body text with optional formatting (bold, italic, color, alignment)
- heading: Section headings (larger font, bold by default)
- image: Inline images that flow with content
- divider: Horizontal line separators
- spacer: Vertical whitespace
- pageBreak: Force new page

Default margins: Varies by page size (e.g., 72pt/1" for Letter, ~56pt for A4).

background.description: Page background color (hex like "#000000" or named color). Default: white.

hyperlink.description: Color for hyperlink text (hex like "#0066CC" or named color). Default: #0066CC (classic browser blue).

bold.description: Use bold font weight (default: false for text, true for heading)

characterSpacing.description: Extra spacing between characters in points (default: 0)

color.description: Text color as hex (e.g., "#333333") or named color (default: black)

continued.description: Continue text on same line (default: false)

fontSize.description: Font size in points (default: 12 for text, 24 for heading)

lineGap.description: Extra spacing between lines in points (default: 0)

moveDown.description: Move cursor down by N lines after rendering (default: 0)

oblique.description: Italic/oblique text - true or angle in degrees (default: false)

paragraphGap.description: Extra spacing after paragraph in points (default: 0)

width.description: Text width for wrapping in points. Without width, text renders on a single line. Width depends on font, font size, and character count. Use text-measure tool for precise dimensions.

wordSpacing.description: Extra spacing between words in points (default: 0)

filename.description: Optional logical filename (metadata only). Storage uses UUID. Defaults to "document.pdf".

font.description: Font strategy (default: auto). Built-ins: Helvetica, Times-Roman, Courier. Use a path or URL for Unicode.

pageSetup.description: Page configuration including size and margins.

margins.description: Page margins in points. all 4 (top, bottom, left, right) are REQUIRED if provided. Defaults vary by page size (LETTER/LEGAL: 72pt, A4: ~56pt).

size.description: Page size preset or custom [width, height] in points. LETTER: 612×792pt (8.5×11in). A4: 595×842pt (210×297mm). LEGAL: 612×1008pt (8.5×14in). Default: LETTER.
